source_only_comparator: H26 current A source-conditioned prediction when known, environmental fallback when new; no protocol mean head
context_warning: H26 has no explicit per-record protocol mean head; context HGB/SVR/RF/LME/NN tables are auxiliary and cannot be called strictly input-matched H26 superiority

BNN_nonhier.implementation: independently retrained original BNN backbone, no source layer

HistGradientBoosting.implementation: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor; local XGBoost not installed

SVR.convergence_policy: retain predictions and warning/fit_status when iteration limit reached

LinearMixedEffects.implementation: Gaussian random-intercept LME, exact group-Woodbury profiled REML via scipy scalar optimization; smoke verified against statsmodels MixedLM
LinearMixedEffects.fixed_effects: intercept+environment; auxiliary context fit adds protocol fixed effects
information: environment and source_only from canonical joint LME
LinearMixedEffects.candidate_budget: variance component estimated by REML, no test-based tuning

NN_fixed_source.implementation: same original domain-specific BNN backbone classes/branches/caps/priors plus jointly learned, unpenalized fixed source intercepts initialized at zero; auxiliary protocol linear head jointly fitted
NN_fixed_source.fitting_change: one group-inner event holdout selects epoch, refit all outer training at selected epoch; unlike H26 source-disjoint mean fit followed by residual source layer
information: environment and source_only from source-only joint fit
NN_fixed_source.interval: NA, no validated observation calibration for joint fixed-source model

resource_budget.estimate_basis: prespecified small trees/SVR at 24k, will update from actual completed units

selection_rule: All hyperparameters fixed a priori. Only NN joint-model epoch selected on source-weighted RMSE of inner site-event grouped validation; no outer-test-based choices. Others use fixed settings/REML training likelihood.

evaluation.single_record_NNSE: NNSE is calculated for evaluation groups
evaluation.new_model_observation_intervals: NA; observation intervals require separate training-based calibration
evaluation.strict_spatial_source_joint_common_holdo: not run for the six-model comparison
